summary: Iteration 7 GREEN for the new Weekly/Wallet segmented control on /customer/payments. Verified end-to-end at 390x844 web preview using a fresh approved customer + admin (9999999999). Default state: payments-tabs visible with tab-weekly + tab-wallet, Weekly active, deposit-card NOT rendered. Switching to Wallet shows deposit-card with testID=wallet-balance and a wallet-list FlatList; after seeding a ₹1000 paid deposit, wallet-row-{id} renders with '+₹1000' + 'Paid' chip. Switching back to Weekly hides the deposit-card. Admin assigned a TEST vehicle (security_deposit=500 ≤ wallet balance 1000) → Weekly tab now shows a pending row; tapping opens confirm-payment-sheet; submitting a UPI txn flips the row to 'Paid · UPI' with Txn line and a new pending row appears for next week. Admin POST /admin/payments/{pid}/mark-paid-cash with body {note} → customer Weekly tab shows the row as 'Paid · Cash' with Txn 'CASH-…'. Regression: tab-history still navigates to /customer/history and PickupAddressCard renders on /customer/home. Screenshots saved under /app/test_reports/screens/it7/.

ui_bugs.component: customer/payments.tsx Top Up sheet (Modal sheet) on web/small heights
ui_bugs.issue: Inside the top-up modal the confirm-top-up-button is laid out at top≈1556px while viewport height is 844px — i.e. ~700px below the fold. The bottom sheet is not scrollable on web, so the user can never reach 'Continue to UPI' without manual scroll. Same risk for confirm-payment-sheet and the deposit confirm sheet on shorter devices. Wrap the sheet content (or the part below the inputs) in a ScrollView, or set maxHeight on the sheet so its content scrolls.

issues: Meta line shows two spaces around the bullet ('Paid 24 Jun  ·  UPI') — minor double-space artifact from the JSX template strings; consider replacing with a single non-breaking-space pair.

Use POST /admin/users/{uid}/approve to fast-approve customers. Seed deposits via /deposits + /deposits/{id}/mark-paid if Top Up modal is still off-screen.
rca_of_issue: Top-up modal overflow: the Modal sheet is a non-scrollable View with sequential children (title, body, label, TextInput, preset chip row, confirmCta button, cancel). At 390x844 with safe-area chrome and the bottom-sheet handle/title, the content's total height exceeds the visible area by ~700px, pushing the 'Continue to UPI' button entirely below the fold. Fix: wrap the sheet content in a ScrollView with contentContainerStyle={{paddingBottom: 24}} OR set sheet maxHeight = window.height * 0.85 + flex:1 on a nested ScrollView. Reproduction: customer/payments → tab-wallet → top-up-button → measure confirm-top-up-button getBoundingClientRect on 390x844.
